headline: We want everyone
standfirst: We are a volunteer group, starting in Barcelona. Panels, workshops, events and more are in the works.

doorways.title: Come to an event
doorways.body: Nothing is scheduled yet. Sign up and we will email you when an event is scheduled.

doorways.title: Volunteer
doorways.body: We need people who can teach, organise, translate, design or write.

doorways.title: Offer a venue
doorways.body: A library, a community hall, an office after hours or a room in a café. If you have a space in or near Barcelona, let us know.

promises.title: Volunteers.
promises.body: We are not a company and we have nothing to sell you.

promises.title: Not an AI lab.
promises.body: We do not build AI or train models.

promises.title: Honest about problems.
promises.body: If a tool is wrong, biased or unsafe, we will say so.

promises.title: Not here to promote AI.
promises.body: We will not try to make you like AI. You decide if it is useful to you.

whyQuote: Make AI an open door, not a locked lab.
whyBody: Most information about AI is written for people who already work in tech. That makes it harder for everyone else to get started. We want anyone to be able to try AI and decide for themselves whether to use it, and what for.
